defects.what: CG characters look plastic and pasted onto painted plates: attendants clip/perch on plinths and statues, Anpu and Ankhu merge into one silhouette, shadows and feet do not match the painted lighting.
Stiff, unnatural poses: Ankhu A-pose and hop, Anpu stiff run-like stride with skating feet, static attendants; sceptre thin and floating.
Rough framing and cuts: 024 extreme close-up crops feet, 025 empty plate before characters pop in, subtitles linger across cuts, 048 cuts to a new dark plate with Ankhu alone and no transition.
